meta.title: 8비트 장터 2026
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (8비트 장터 2026, a retro game fair (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A dusk market in a small palette: sky bands from #2B1B4A through #8A2F6B and #F2784B to #FFB37A, dithered where they meet; lantern orange #FF8A3D, coin gold #FFD84A, awnings red #E8475F or blue #3B7DD8 against cream #FFF3E0, cobbles #7A5A50; outlines #1A1423.
rationale.type: Galmuri11 only, always at its 12 px grid or a whole multiple (24, 36) in a 480 x 270 buffer shown at 4x, through an alpha threshold so every letter pixel is a crisp 4 x 4 block; a 1-pixel shadow under HUD and labels.
rationale.motion: Game motion: the hero runs on two frames and jumps on the beat in parabolas, coins spin in four widths, the ? block bumps, scores float up; text types a character at a time; the boot screen flashes in stepped tones; fireworks burst in pixels.
rationale.sound: Chiptune at 144 BPM in C major (9 bars in 15 s, 18 in 30 s): square leads, a triangle bass and noise drums; coin pings on every pickup, a stamp for the block.
rationale.visuals: All code: string sprites (the hero, the ? glyph, a heart), coins and blocks from rectangles, a dithered sky, a parallax skyline and hills, stalls with striped awnings and signs, lantern strings, a gate, fireworks, a HUD.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a game speaks in pings.
